text:
Alyssa: Quick sync on HaloEdge preview: partner wants telemetry but forbids kernel modules on our hosted marketplace images. They proposed a proxy mode that streams aggregated samples to their agent. Who owns engineering and legal checklist?
James: I can handle partner coordination + marketplace listing constraints. Need the exact telemetry fields and attestation flow.
Nora (Partner PM): We can publish a proxy agent that reads /sys stats and POSTs aggregated JSON. Fields: timestamp, p_total_w, avg_temp_c, throttled_pct. TTL token required. No kernel modules.
Ben: Eng-runtime: proxy mode works for us. We need schema + sample payloads. Also confirm sampling interval (they propose 1s).
Alyssa: Let's standardize on 5s sampling for hosted runs to reduce overhead and align with our billing SLOs. James, confirm with Nora.
Nora (Partner PM): 5s OK. We'll provide sample telemetry and a small docker image for the proxy.
Ben: Perf command (local dry run): `./bench --model l2-7b-ptq --telemetry proxy://localhost:9001 --samples 100`
CI-bot: queued perf job: haloedge-proxy-1745550000-01 -> hosted-sandbox, ETA 12m :rocket:
Elaine (Legal): NDA ok with proxy mode. For marketplace listing we need to agree embargo language and who approves copy. Please send any coauth blog drafts to legal before publishing. 60-day telemetry retention requested? Provide justification.
Alyssa: Owners: James (partner & marketplace copy), Ben (bench + proxy integration), Elaine (legal). Goal: sandbox runs by Thu, draft coauth outline after results. Post any sample payloads to shared drive and tag Elaine. :thumbsup:
